mentions.name: Multi
mentions.description: Multi is an AI coding agent built from scratch by a group of FOSS contributors, taking a drastically different approach to core features, tech stack, and UX/devex than existing tools like Cline and Roo, whose tech the team studied as active users and developers. It is in the process of being open sourced, and the team is seeking feedback from users of similar tools.
mentions.audience: Active users of similar AI coding tools and anyone who wants to try Multi
